## Change and reason

Describe the resulting behavior and the problem it fixes.

## Branch direction

State the parent and target. Shared work starts at development; Windows-only
work starts at platform/windows. Explain any release, hotfix or sync PR.

## Verification and limits

- [ ] Relevant unit tests pass.
- [ ] Windows packaging check passes.
- [ ] Affected native/interactive checks recorded with OS and source commit.
- [ ] Docs and release notes reflect incomplete or unverified behavior.
- [ ] No unrelated edits, secrets, captures, models or local voice data included.

List commands/results and remaining risks. Mark inapplicable checks explicitly.
